allocator_observation: A prior FLUX request recorded a 5245 MiB largest free direct-memory block and failed a 5939.93 MiB CPU buffer allocation. After the idle SDXL adapter released its allocations, the largest free block measured 9839 MiB. This is evidence that the 5 GiB result was state-dependent, not a fixed Vulkan allocator ceiling. The Vulkan heap budget and the PS5 direct-memory largest block are separate measurements.
